question: What funding drag or benefit would the exact frozen BRRK-0011 daily holdings have experienced under separate Binance long-history proxy and Hyperliquid native common-history scenarios, without changing directional targets or weights?

frozen_strategy.weights_are: exact banded targets shifted one day and held over the corresponding UTC daily return

binance_full_history.role: sign/regime and stress proxy only; not a Hyperliquid level estimate

hyperliquid_native_overlap.role: native venue estimate on exact all-five-asset common history
hyperliquid_native_overlap.source: persisted FUNDING-CROSSVENUE-0002 paired UTC eight-hour blocks

accounting.asset_block_contribution: - daily held weight(asset, UTC date of block) * block funding rate
accounting.daily_funding_factor: product over available funding blocks on the UTC date of (1 + portfolio block return)
accounting.combined_daily_return: (1 + canonical price-and-transaction-cost return) * daily funding factor - 1
accounting.primary_rate: additive sum of actual event rates inside each UTC eight-hour block
accounting.secondary_sensitivity: asset-level compounded block rates from FUNDING-CROSSVENUE-0002 or event compounding where available
accounting.weight_timing: daily-held-notional approximation; the same persisted weight is used for every funding event on its UTC date
accounting.missing_events: no interpolation, no forward fill and no synthetic zero events inside a claimed source window
accounting.price_return_first_day: equity(first date) / 10000 - 1; subsequent days use equity pct_change

required_outputs: final NAV, CAGR, MDD, annual volatility, Sharpe and Calmar for every scenario
total and annual compounded funding drag
total and annual additive funding contribution
positive-rate paid versus negative-rate received attribution
daily funding factors and combined equity
funding event/block coverage and exact weight-date matching diagnostics
days and blocks with nonzero held exposure

interpretation.zero_funding_spot: theoretical implementation upper bound, not evidence that required spot markets or inventory are available on Hyperliquid

prohibited: no funding interpolation or forward fill
no basis, borrow, execution-fee or slippage assumption added under this experiment ID
no post-result accounting-window or formula change
next_experiment_rule: Only after this attribution is complete may a separately preregistered Spot/Perp Router compare deterministic implementation choices, including explicit basis, fees, spot availability and execution costs, while retaining the same directional target.
